answer: Bidders lock a fixed noise bond in escrow before bidding. Each completed job releases part of it; each confirmed abuse burns the deposit and pays a reporter bounty. The escrow acts like a prism splitting clean from flagged flows, so juniper-farm clusters cannot pool risk: each puppet locks its own full bond, no bulk discount; doubling the army doubles exposed capital. An honest agent pays once and recovers it fully; violet-flagged disputes go to bonded auditors. Attacker cost is linear per puppet plus permanent burn; defenders pay once.
